findings.location: Paragraph: "He astounds the local rabbi with his knowledge of the scriptures." (source.html)
findings.source_quote: He astounds the local rabbi with his knowledge of the scriptures.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the phrase to standard Swahili meaning "the local rabbi" and the verb "astounds" correctly. Example: "Anawashangaza marabi wa mtaa kwa ufahamu wake wa maandiko." (Preserve surrounding sentence structure and tags.)
findings.translation_quote: Anamshangaza myezi wa mahubiri wa mahali kwa ufahamu wake wa maandiko.

findings.location: Paragraph: "and was spat upon." (source.html, sentence describing treatment of Jesus)
findings.source_quote: He saw Jesus being brutally handled, falsely accused, and spat upon.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a correct Swahili rendering for "spat upon" (meaning to have saliva spat on him). Example: "...akitendewa kwa ukatili, akihojiwa kwa uongo, na kumwagiliwa mate."
findings.translation_quote: Aliona Yesu akitendewa kwa ukatili, akihojiwa kwa uongo, na kukamatwa mate.

findings.location: Paragraph: "we commit the details to our Master." (source.html)
findings.source_quote: We commit the details to our Master.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the untranslated English word and supply proper Swahili for "details". For example: "Tunamkabidhi Bwana wetu maelezo ya kila undani." or "Tunamkabidhi Bwana wetu mambo yote kwa undani." Preserve sentence punctuation and tags.
findings.translation_quote: Tunamipa Bwana wetu maelezo da details.

findings.location: Paragraph: "He doesn’t equip us until He determines that we are ready." (source.html)
findings.source_quote: Jesus never calls us without equipping us, and He doesn’t equip us until He determines that we are ready.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the garbled verb in Swahili. Example: "Yesu hatutuita bila kutujalia vifaa, na hatutapati vifaa hadi aonekane kwamba tuko tayari." or "...na hatutumuingiwa mpaka aamua kwamba tuko tayari."
findings.translation_quote: Yesu hatumwiti bila kutubariki kwa vifaa, na hatusiagi hadi atakapothibitisha kwamba tuko tayari.
